import hashlib,json,sys,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/lucky/devdir/rgzndl')
sys.path[:0]=[str(ROOT),str(ROOT/'tests')]
from test_paper_registration import PaperRegistrationTests,BASE,sha,write
paths=['src/ect/paper_registration.py','tests/test_paper_registration.py','scripts/verify_paper_run.py','tests/test_verify_paper_run.py']
before={p:sha(ROOT/p) for p in paths}
PaperRegistrationTests.setUpClass()
out=[]
cases=['valid','missing_report','missing_model','missing_validation_csv','unrelated_json','wrong_report_sha','wrong_metrics','wrong_group_metrics','missing_flags','tf32_enabled','wrong_seed','wrong_crop_script_text','wrong_crop_script_sha','zero_parameter_update','metric_rounding_allowed','metric_error_exceeds_tolerance']
try:
 for mode in cases:
  case=PaperRegistrationTests()
  try:
   with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    root=Path(tmp);m,acceptance,output=case.fixture(root)
    content=json.loads(acceptance.read_text());item=content['runs'][0]
    run=root/item['run_dir'];proofpath=root/item['verification_path'];proof=json.loads(proofpath.read_text())
    if mode.startswith('missing_') and mode!='missing_flags':
     name={'missing_report':'report.json','missing_model':'model.pt','missing_validation_csv':'validation_predictions.csv'}[mode]
     p=run/name;p.unlink();content['files_sha256'].pop(p.relative_to(root).as_posix())
    elif mode=='unrelated_json':
     content.pop('runs');p=root/'unrelated.json';write(p,{'unrelated':True});content['files_sha256']={'unrelated.json':sha(p)}
    elif mode=='zero_parameter_update':
     p=run/'report.json';report=json.loads(p.read_text());report['parameter_update_l2']=0;write(p,report)
     content['files_sha256'][p.relative_to(root).as_posix()]=sha(p);proof['report_sha256']=sha(p)
    elif mode=='wrong_report_sha':proof['report_sha256']='0'*64
    elif mode=='wrong_metrics':proof['metrics']['train']['accuracy']+=.01
    elif mode=='wrong_group_metrics':proof['group_metrics']={}
    elif mode=='missing_flags':proof['flags'].pop('independent_inference')
    elif mode=='tf32_enabled':proof['determinism']['tf32']=True
    elif mode=='wrong_seed':proof['determinism']['seed']=1
    elif mode=='wrong_crop_script_text':proof['script']['text']+='\n# wrong crop verifier\n'
    elif mode=='wrong_crop_script_sha':proof['script']['sha256']='0'*64
    elif mode in ('metric_rounding_allowed','metric_error_exceeds_tolerance'):
     delta=1e-14 if mode=='metric_rounding_allowed' else 1e-6
     proof['metrics']['train']['accuracy']+=delta;proof['maximum_metric_error']=delta
    write(proofpath,proof);content['files_sha256'][proofpath.relative_to(root).as_posix()]=sha(proofpath);write(acceptance,content)
    want_ok=mode in ('valid','metric_rounding_allowed')
    try:
     base,evidence,files=m._collect_inputs(root,'config/paper_baseline_v1.json',BASE['cache_dir'],acceptance)
    except ValueError as error:
     if want_ok:raise
     assert not output.exists();out.append({'case':mode,'result':'rejected','reason':str(error).replace(str(root),'TEMP')})
    else:
     assert want_ok,f'Unexpected acceptance: {mode}'
     assert len(evidence['code_sha256'])==13
     out.append({'case':mode,'result':'accepted','source_count':13})
  finally:case.doCleanups()
finally:PaperRegistrationTests.doClassCleanups()
after={p:sha(ROOT/p) for p in paths}
assert before==after,'Sources changed during review: repeat in a fresh process'
print(json.dumps({'checks':out,'source_sha256':after,'fixture_only':True,'cuda_executed':False},indent=2))
